config.blocking_selection: fastest full tuning median among configurations within the hard allocated-index budget and reaching 95% exact-NN success within the per-query deadline
config.baseline_selection: fastest full tuning median among configurations within the same hard allocated-index budget and reaching 95% exact-NN success within the per-query deadline
config.tuning_guard_note: 95% empirical tuning is a conservative selection guard for a 90% held-out exact-NN-within-deadline requirement; it is not a population-recall certificate.
config.posting_compression: unique (fingerprint,parent) per table for every indexed method
config.feasibility_scope: largest feasible TESTED k in 4..12; every required index seed must meet the serving-index budget and 90% exact-NN success within 10 ms; raw curves and scratch RAM are separate

notes: Maximum is over the tested object counts and configuration shortlist only.
Every seed must meet both allocated-index and exact-NN-within-deadline requirements.
Raw curves and query scratch are excluded from the serving-index budget.
No configurations are substituted after held-out evaluation.
